normal_reference_basis: Human-reviewed normal bottle at source 13.0 seconds. Its numeric reference is recomputed from the actual RF-DETR bottle and liquid masks, not copied from the old color-strip measurement.
tolerance_basis: Demonstration tolerance in relative detected-bottle visible height; not a factory specification, volume measurement or learned quality threshold.

exterior.basis: Separately reviewed exterior regions outside the stationary bottle. Used only for visible overflow evidence; never for liquid level, bottle arrival or completion. Not a learned spill detector.
exterior.persistence_basis: Reviewed visible exterior bursts span 0.25 seconds (seven consecutive 24fps frames). Duration is last minus first timestamp. The old four-fps len/fps gate called two samples 0.5 seconds despite their endpoints being 0.25 seconds apart. This explicit demo recalibration preserves the actual observed duration, never a full-bottle proxy.
